system_configurations.name: RCCL-Tests-NET-IB-Transport
system_configurations.description: Comprehensive InfiniBand transport test config. Runs all NetIbMPITest tests including plugin API, physical device, and virtual device (vNIC) tests.

mpi_args.mellanox: --mca oob_tcp_if_include eth1 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eth1 --mca btl ^vader,openib --bind-to none
mpi_args.ainic: --mca oob_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl ^vader,openib --bind-to none
mpi_args.thor2: --oversubscribe --mca plm_rsh_agent srun --mca oob_tcp_if_include eno8303 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno8303 --mca btl ^openib --bind-to none

socket_poll_bootstrap.description: Bootstrap socket busy-loop regression. Validates that NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC makes a blocked bootstrap socket recv wait in poll() instead of pinning a CPU core at 100%. Single node, no NIC/GPU required.

tests.name: Socket_BootstrapPollNoBusyLoop
tests.description: With NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC set, a receiver blocked on a slow peer sleeps in poll() (low CPU); the control case with the param at 0 reproduces the pre-fix busy loop (high CPU).

tests.name: GdrFlush_CuMemDmaBuf_NoAsyncFatal
tests.description: Whitebox ncclIbIflush over a dma-buf (cuMem/UBR) RO=0 flush scratchpad - the exact path that used to raise the mlx5 'invalid request local work queue error'. The read-only flush (RDMA_READ fence, WRITE removed) must complete cleanly with correct data.

tests.name: GdrFlush_Peermem_NoAsyncFatal
tests.description: Whitebox ncclIbIflush over a legacy peermem (ibv_reg_mr) RO=0 scratchpad. Confirms the fix keeps the peermem read path working (never regressed).

tests.name: GdrFlush_FeatureDisabled_Fallback
tests.description: Whitebox ncclIbIflush fallback branch: with the dedicated RO=0 scratchpad disabled it reads the received buffer directly (upstream-NCCL behaviour).

tests.name: GdrFlush_RepeatedFlushBurst
tests.description: 50-iteration GPU recv+flush burst over the dma-buf scratchpad; an intermittent QP async-fatal would surface as a non-success flush. The whole burst must stay clean.

tests.name: GdrFlush_ForcedScratchpadWrite_ReproducesFault
tests.description: Regression guard (ENABLE_FAULT_INJECTION debug builds only): forces the removed scratchpad RDMA_WRITE back on a dma-buf buffer and asserts the flush QP faults, proving the WRITE was the culprit. Absent/skipped when fault injection is not compiled in.

cast_shim_leak_guard.description: Runs the shim-leak probe in a plain CAST configuration, where RCCL_IB_FAULT_INJECTION is simply absent. The damage a leak does is process-wide and has nothing to do with threading, so the guard belongs in an ordinary run and not only in the threaded fault suites.

tests.name: Cast_FaultShimsAbsentUnlessRequested
tests.description: Arming an ops-level fault must be refused while RCCL_IB_FAULT_INJECTION is off, which is only true while the libibverbs shims are absent. If they are present, every poll_cq in the process pays for a global mutex twice

net_ib_multithread_base.description: Shared environment for the threaded suites. Deliberately carries no tests: extends merges test lists rather than replacing them, so a threaded suite that extended a suite with tests would also run those tests, at whatever worker count it sets.

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_IndependentSimpleSendRecv
tests.description: Independent worker connections concurrently execute one host-memory send/receive each

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_IndependentSequentialTransfers
tests.description: Independent worker connections concurrently execute sequential host-memory transfers

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MultipleSizes
tests.description: Concurrent workers sweep the size ladder, filling the shared per-device MR cache with registrations of many sizes

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_ProgressDoesNotSerialize
tests.description: Gate: the same transfer loop at one worker and at all of them, so a lock held across a progress call shows up as time that scales with the worker count. Skips below four workers

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_LargeTransfer
tests.description: Concurrent 16 MB transfers keep several large registrations live on one device

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MemoryRegistrationStorm
tests.description: Concurrent register/deregister storms race the insert, lookup and release paths of the per-device MR cache

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MrCacheRefCount
tests.description: All workers register the same address, contending on one cache entry's refcount

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MixedSizeBarrage
tests.description: Concurrent workers walk 1 B to 64 MB, exercising alignment and chunking under bandwidth pressure

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_TagZeroReuse
tests.description: Every worker reuses tag 0 on its own connection, so a misrouted completion shows up as a data mismatch

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_RequestSlotExhaustion
tests.description: Concurrent workers hold 32 requests each in flight on one NIC and verify slot recycling

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_RapidRecvPostDrain
tests.description: Concurrent post-and-drain batches, so recycling holds up while other communicators drain

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_FifoPressure
tests.description: N slow receivers against N tight senders, with the backpressure assertion kept per connection

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_LongRunningEndurance
tests.description: Sustained concurrent traffic with the RDMA leak check taken around the whole run

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_GpuMemoryTransfer
tests.description: Concurrent GPU-buffer registrations drive the peer-memory path into the shared MR cache

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MultiQpSplitData
tests.description: Concurrent workers multiply the QPs in flight per device while each checks its own split payloads

tests.name: NetIB_MultiThread_MultiQpNoSplit
tests.description: Same concurrent sweep on the nDataQps path

cast_wrr_split_long_interval.description: Extends cast_base rather than cast_wrr_split so it does not also inherit that suite's tests, several of which need the RTT timer to fire and would fail at this interval.

tests.name: Cast_EnableDisableSched_LongInterval
tests.description: Toggle schedEnable mid-connection. Needs an update interval above 10 s so the RTT timer cannot rewrite tokens mid-assertion; the default 50 us makes this test skip

cast_wrr_no_split_long_interval.description: Extends cast_base rather than cast_wrr_no_split for the same reason as its split counterpart.

tests.name: Cast_WeightsDistributionOneRound_LongInterval
tests.description: Two-phase WRR distribution with the RTT timer suspended

tests.name: Cast_AlternatingWrrNonWrr_LongInterval
tests.description: Toggle doWrr mid-connection with the RTT timer suspended

tests.name: Cast_EnableDisableSplitData_LongInterval
tests.description: Toggle splitData at the threshold with the RTT timer suspended

test_suites.name: Bootstrap socket poll - no busy loop
test_suites.description: AICOMRCCL-1322: NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC makes a blocked bootstrap socket recv wait in poll() instead of busy-spinning a CPU core (Debug only, no NIC/GPU required)
